Button

Trigger an operation, for example, submits a form.

Sample Code

Button type

The button type can be default, primary, info, warning, and danger. The default type is default.

<maui-button type="default">default button</maui-button>
<maui-button type="primary">primary button</maui-button>
<maui-button type="info">information button</maui-button>
<maui-button type="warning">warning button</maui-button>
<maui-button type="danger">danger button</maui-button>

Plain button

Use the plain attribute to set the button to a plain button, with the font color as the button color and the background as white.

<maui-button plain type="primary">plain button </maui-button> <maui-button plain type="info">plain button </maui-button>

Hairline border

Use the hairline attribute to enable a 0.5-pixel border, based on the pseudo class.

<maui-button plain hairline type="primary">hairline border button </maui-button>
<maui-button plain hairline type="info">hairline border button </maui-button>

Disabled

Use the disabled attribute to disable a button. In this case, the bind:click event is not triggered for the button.

<maui-button disabled type="primary">disabled</maui-button> <maui-button disabled type="info">disabled</maui-button>

Loading

<maui-button loading type="primary" />
<maui-button loading type="primary" loading-type="spinner" />
<maui-button loading type="info" loading-text="Loading..." />

Button shape

<maui-button square type="primary">square button</maui-button> <maui-button round type="info">round button</maui-button>

Icon button

Use the icon attribute to set the button icon. The icon URL can be transferred.

<maui-button icon="https://example/logo.png" type="info"> button </maui-button>

Button size

The button size can be large, normal, small, or mini. The default size is normal.

<maui-button type="primary" size="large">large button </maui-button>
<maui-button type="primary" size="normal">normal button</maui-button>
<maui-button type="primary" size="small">small button</maui-button>
<maui-button type="primary" size="mini">mini button</maui-button>

Block-level element

Use the block attribute to set the button to a block-level element.

<maui-button type="primary" block>block-level element </maui-button>

Custom color

Use the color attribute to customize the button color.

<maui-button color="#7232dd">single-color button</maui-button>
<maui-button color="#7232dd" plain>single-color button</maui-button>
<maui-button color="linear-gradient(to right, #4bb0ff, #6149f6)"> Gradient color button </maui-button>

API

Props

Attribute Description Type Default Value
id Identifier. String -
type Button type. The options are primary, info, warning, and danger. String default
size Button size. The options are normal, large, small, and mini. String normal
color Button color. The linear-gradient color is allowed. String -
icon Icon link on the left. String
plain Whether the button is a plain button. Boolean false
block Whether the button is a block-level element. Boolean false
round Whether the button is round. Boolean false
square Whether the button is square. Boolean false
disabled Whether the button is disabled. Boolean false
hairline Whether to use the 0.5-pixel border. Boolean false
loading Whether to display the loading state. Boolean false
loading-text Text indicating the loading state. String -
loading-type Type of the loading icon. The value can be spinner. String circular
loading-size Size of the loading icon. String 20px
custom-style Custom style. String -

Events

Event Description Parameter
bind:click Triggered when a button is clicked and the button status is not loading or disabled. -
